prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish copy, and finish new_screen because each has only been tested once.
For sign_in hints, two tests agreed showing no clear effect.
Evidence for home new_flow remains thin as the two tests yielded conflicting results (one win, one no clear effect).
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, copy: -0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -0.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Waiting room animated stage layout: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout with a visible step counter and active pet creation progress updates. (why: Adoption to home waiting step sees drop-off (87.4%) and a high mean time of 2,336s, indicating users disengage during rendering.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet placement sandbox screen: Insert a desktop positioning sandbox screen before home_intro so users can test dragging and placing their pet on the desktop. (why: Multiple support tickets report pets not appearing on desktop or users being confused about how to move and interact with them.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path spotlight interactive layout: Redesign choose_path screen into a spotlight card layout highlighting quick adoption versus custom creation. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean duration of 514s, pointing to hesitation and decision friction at entry.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop overlay readiness hint: Add explicit desktop permission and system overlay status indicators on the waiting screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to launch after setup.)
4: [finish, layout] Home intro two-column layout: Change home_intro screen to a two-column layout presenting companion control shortcuts alongside finish settings. (why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and support users report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account sync assurance sign in copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to reassure users that signing in backs up their companion data. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or account data reset after signing back in.)
6: [choose_path, notification] Story screen progress indicator: Enable progress bar and step counter on the initial story screen. (why: The choose_path phase shows high mean time (514s), indicating users delay moving past initial introductory screens.)
7: [adoption, new_screen] Companion preview confirmation screen: Add a companion confirmation screen after photo upload to review pet attributes before entering generation. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pets looking wrong or failing after setup.)
8: [finish, incentive] Companion control tip carousel: Add a tip carousel component on home_intro explaining right-click menus, desktop hiding, and pet interaction. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to talk to, hide, or control the desktop pet.)
